data.name: AlDaar
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Al-Daar means ‘the doorkeeper’. It is a name that signifies protection, security, and hospitality. In Islamic history, Al-Daar refers to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) who was a doorkeeper (Sabiq) for his uncle, Abu Talib, before becoming a Messenger of Allah.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of protection and hospitality in Islam.
data.numerology_meaning: People with the name AlDaar tend to be natural leaders with strong willpower and a deep sense of purpose. They have the potential to achieve great things in their lives, but they must also learn to balance their ambition with compassion and understanding for others.
